title: Expand a Euclidean bilinear form in coordinates
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Expand a Euclidean bilinear form in coordinates. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let H be a continuous real bilinear form on a finite-dimensional Euclidean coordinate space. Evaluating H on vectors x and y gives the sum over ordered coordinate pairs of their coordinates multiplied by the corresponding basis entry.
